# Catalog fixtures

These minimized fixtures exercise the response fields documented by each provider on 2026-10-15.

- OpenRouter: `https://openrouter.ai/docs/api/api-reference/models/list-all-models-and-their-properties`
- Groq: `https://console.groq.com/docs/api-reference`

Model ids and pricing values are test values; the JSON field names and nesting follow the provider catalog examples.
